name: checkrein
description: An enforcing install gate for skills and plugins (quarantine, scan, ledger, drift check), a guard that stops secrets being written into files, commands or outbound tool calls, and deterministic rules against guard tampering. Stdlib Python, no network, no dependencies.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: relaxed asks where standard denies; strict adds the shared-tree rules, the staged-commit scan and the MCP write gate. Project files can only make this stricter.

fail_mode.title: If checkrein itself fails
fail_mode.description: What happens when a config file is broken or the guard crashes: ask you, deny the action, or allow it silently.

scanner_command.title: Skill scanner command (optional)
scanner_command.description: A third-party scanner the install gate runs on quarantined code. Use {path} for the folder and {report} for a report file, e.g. skillspector scan {path} --no-llm --format json --output {report}. Leave empty to use only the built-in checks (verdicts then stop at REVIEW).
